notes.text:
Issued in a glossy picture sleeve and on red and green labels with 'Made in England' at the end of the rim text.
Most copies with a Virgin Mid-Price Range generic card inner sleeve [BAG1] with a full list of titles in the series. 
Unlike

, this reissue has a barcode.

Title on front cover: Angel's Egg; on back cover and spine: Radio Gnome 2  Angels Egg

Some early copies used up left over Virgin V2007 sleeves and had a round "OVED 15" sticker placed over the catalogue number on the top right of the back cover. The spine reads "V2007" as per the previous 1970s pressings.

Recorded by Manor Mobile 24 Track Studios chez Gong at Pavillion du Hay in France at full moon August 1973.
